summary: As a small business owner using WhatsApp Business, I find the manual toggling of away messages and greetings mildly annoying but not painful enough to pay for a dedicated scheduling tool. The native app already offers a basic custom schedule for a single away message, which covers my most common use case. I would not actively search for this solution unless it were free or extremely cheap. I am skeptical of third-party apps due to reliability and ToS concerns. I would not buy this at any meaningful price point.
strongest_points: The native WhatsApp Business app already provides a basic custom schedule for away messages (single message), which reduces the pain of manual toggling for many scenarios.
If the solution were free or very low-cost (e.g., $1-2/month), I might consider it as a convenience, but I would not pay more.
The idea of scheduling multiple messages per time/day is appealing, but not urgent enough to justify a paid subscription.
weaknesses: Low pain intensity (score 2) and low willingness to pay (score 1) indicate I am unlikely to spend money on this.
Trust blockers: I worry about WhatsApp ToS violations, data privacy, and reliability of third-party apps. I would not risk my business account for a minor convenience.
Existing free alternatives (native app, basic schedule) and cheap partial solutions (ManyChat free plan) reduce the need for a dedicated scheduler.
